Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL1936. Join molecule_dictionary to activities via molregno, join activities to assays via assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary via tid. Filter assays.assay_organism equals Homo sapiens and target_dictionary.chembl_id equals CHEMBL1936. Left join compound_structures to include canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
